{{Top|leg}}
The '''Binexan Shark''' was a legendary [[Shark/Legends|shark]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. A predatory creature, the Binexan Shark was said to rise back out of the ocean depths in a new and more deadly form when defeated.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Binexan-class Destroyer}}</ref> The [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Shuuru]] compared the threat of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to the Binexan Shark.<ref name="Since KOTOR">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20140718|text=Since KOTOR: Manaan}}</ref>

The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Binexan-class Destroyer]] was named after it.<ref name="CX" />
